::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **styles the viewer from a stylesheet**. `css-class:
slate-viewer` adds that class to the viewer, and `n-css-class.css`, set
with `css:` in the header, uses it to set the viewer's colours and to make
the caption larger and italic. Only pages with that class get the rules,
so the other pages of the site keep the default viewer.
:::

The stylesheet:

```css
.slate-viewer {
  --panzoom-backdrop: rgba(20, 24, 33, 0.95);
  --panzoom-bg: #141821;
  --panzoom-fg: #e6e6e6;
  --panzoom-link: #8ab4f8;
}
.slate-viewer .panzoom-caption {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-style: italic;
}
```
